limitations: Smoke tests, deterministic on/off comparisons and in-game shadow comparisons; not exhaustive gameplay, every option combination or long sessions.
Ported from Forge 1.0.33 as a delta on the published 1.0.30.1+mc1.21.1 and reconciled with the frozen Forge 1.0.33 release named in base; its default values are the same.

Shadow helpers with no work in any fixture (their mods are installed, but nothing in the scripted scenes reached the code): BakeLocations, CubeBakeMemo, CucumberTileDispatch, EmptyFilters, FramedMaps, RedPandaGate, SearchReplay, SortedConnections, SpawnerPresence. Their switches are guarded and applied where installed, with static and code-comparison evidence.

Terrain on/off equality is proven on the base game, on the TerraBlender/BWG fixture without Dynamic Trees (Dynamic Trees grows its Nether fungus trees differently from run to run; 1.0.30 port evidence), and next to Generator Accelerator 1.6.2 and Bye Pregen 1.1.3.0.
Next to another mod that hooks the same NoiseChunk calls the three NoiseChunk switches stand down (as in the Forge 1.0.33 release); call_site_lines lists every such line the fixtures wrote.
Citadel 2.7.1 has no 1.21.1 NeoForge consumer mod to render through (Alex's Mobs/Caves, Rats, Ice and Fire unported): its switch is guarded and applies, but its model path ran on no real model.
Cucumber dispatch: guarded and applied; no Cucumber block entity dispatched to a player in the rigs.

Switches without a shadow mode (GeckoLib bone queues/quad vectors, Citadel/LionfishAPI vertices, FancyMenu, Pehkui, climate tree keys/spans, climate column parts, Distant Horizons byte stream, the JEI start-up switches) rest on the 1.20.1 proofs plus the 1.21.1 code comparisons made for this port, the terrain comparisons, the tooltip-word differential test and clean in-game behaviour.
The Collections Of Optimizations step-aside entries are kept; no build of that mod exists for 1.21.1 NeoForge to test them against.

In the client runs the scripted hostile mobs killed the survival probe player in most runs on this test PC; the published 1.0.30.1+mc1.21.1 and a run with every switch off did the same (client_scene_player_deaths). The probe and the shadow comparisons ran to the end either way.

Generator Accelerator 1.6.2 sometimes stops generating chunks by itself (spawn preparation or a synchronous chunk load never finishes, every thread idle, nothing logged): seen with Generator Accelerator alone, with every Bons and Furious switch off and with them on (evidence/ga-hang-diagnostics.json). Its fixtures are the runs that got through.
No performance benchmark or FPS gain is claimed for the port.
No publication, no managed instance installation, no managed world edits.
